name: brine-theme
description: Dark violet/indigo theme for the Pterodactyl Panel user area - #19152e page, #2b254c surfaces, #2b87d3 accent, fixed sidebar shell, redesigned dashboard, login, console and file manager. Admin area, favicon and page title untouched.

files.note: Emits every colour utility as rgb(var(--pt-*)) on Tailwind 3.1+ and as baked-in hex on 2.1/3.0, which cannot apply an opacity modifier to a CSS variable; adds navy/gold brand ramps and aliases blue/primary to navy and cyan to gold

Stock head (title, favicons, theme-color) + palette stylesheet link only, plus data-pt-theme on <html> and a theme-color that follows the chosen palette - both server-rendered so a variant never shows the default for a frame
ptColor() helper for Chart.js - dark-only, no theme state

brandName()/logoUrl()/registrationEnabled()/backgroundStyle()/quickLinks()/linkHref() - site name, icon (pasted link wins over the uploaded file), registration switch, the two background slots and the Home/Discord/Status links from window.SiteConfiguration

Violet/indigo tokens (#19152e page, #2b254c surface, #2b87d3 accent, system fonts), a fixed violet/cyan aurora field behind every screen, frosted glass on the sidebar/topbar/drawer/auth card and tinted glass on the cards, admin-set background image layers with an adjustable black scrim over the auth screens and the dashboard, auth breadcrumb + quick-link buttons, compact auth card, the round small loading ring, and [data-pt-theme] blocks for the blue / black / navy palettes (navy is flat: no gradients, no glow, no frosted blur) - shell/auth/dashboard/console/file-manager styles
Brand mark used by the sidebar and the login screen

Admin-configured Home/Discord/Status links: <AuthLinks> row above the auth card, <TopbarLinkCluster> centred pills in the dashboard topbar. Discord is the real brand mark, inlined as SVG because the panel does not ship free-brands-svg-icons
Fixed sidebar + sticky topbar + mobile drawer shell for dashboard and server routes, applies the dashboard background image; sign-out lives in the sidebar since the topbar no longer has it
Aternos-style sidebar with brand block (site icon shown with no chip or background, falling back to the first letter), permission-filtered server/account navigation, sign-out button and user footer
Three-column topbar (1fr auto 1fr): burger + title, the centred Home/Discord/Status pill cluster, and a balancing spacer - search, admin, avatar, sign-out and the old dashboard shortcut removed
Wraps the dashboard in AppShell and drops the legacy SubNavigation
Wraps server routes in AppShell and drops the legacy SubNavigation
Auth routes: centres the login card, adds /auth/register, applies the auth background image, and owns the Home / Login breadcrumb pinned to the page top-left
Login card: centred container, logo chip header, title/subtitle slot, the quick-link buttons above the card, and the conditional Register link footer
Login form + success flash after registration (?registered=1)
Public registration form (email, first/last name, username, password, confirm) posting to /auth/register
CSRF + POST /auth/register client
Same treatment for the 2FA checkpoint screen
Same treatment for the password recovery screen
Same treatment for the password reset screen
Branded hero header, section title and empty state
Server cards with status/allocation chips, CPU/MEM/DISK stat blocks and colour bars
Adds the shared footer: Powered by the panel's own site name via brandName(), plus a Design copyright brineajay credit line

Replaces the stock loading ring: caps every size at 22px (stock large was 64px with m-20 of dead margin) and re-asserts border-radius 50% with !important, which the theme's universal `* { border-radius: 0 !important; }` square-corner reset otherwise flattened into a box. Ring colour follows --pt-gold-500
Sharp 3px buttons with uppercase letter-spaced labels
Branded console header with status chip and gold call-to-action power button
Marks the Start button for the gold call-to-action treatment
Terminal chrome: window bar, dots, title and command hint
Navy-black terminal, neutral stat cards and gold accents
Console detail stat blocks re-skinned to neutral cards with gold icons
Resolves chart palette through ptColor()
Resolves chart grid/tick/line colours through ptColor()
Toolbar layout and branded empty state
Navy path bar with gold links and monospaced type
Card-style file rows with icon tiles, size and modified columns
File manager row, tile, empty-state and mass-action styles
Branded selection bar with selection counter

Admin -> Site Settings: site name, icon (uploaded file or pasted link), the two background slots (auth/dashboard - upload or pasted link, each with an on/off switch, its own Save button and a black overlay intensity slider), the panel palette picker (default/blue/black/navy) and the Home/Discord/Status quick links

Responsive Site Settings page with server-rendered tabs (no tab JS): General (name + icon with preview, then a separate Login & register and Dashboard background block, each with upload/link, on-off switch, intensity slider, live preview and its own Save), Theme (palette cards with colour swatches, validated server-side against a whitelist) and Links (Home/Discord/Status, each with a switch and URL). Preview script is vanilla and inlined at the end of @section('content') so it cannot replace the layout's footer-scripts block
POST /auth/register - creates the account directly with the panel's own UserCreationService (hashed password, welcome e-mail, no API key)
Admin -> Registration: enable/disable public sign-up
Registration settings page with the enable switch

Exposes SiteConfiguration.logo / .registration.enabled / .backgrounds / .overlay / .links / .theme.variant; validates link targets and the palette slug server-side against a whitelist; reports recaptcha as disabled so the widget never renders and the exhausted-quota lockout cannot happen
Stock auth routes + GET/POST /auth/register, throttled; drops the stock recaptcha middleware, which would reject every login with HTTP 400 once the shared public keys exhaust their quota
Stock routes + /admin/site-settings + /admin/registration; /admin/branding now redirects to Site Settings
Stock admin layout + Site Settings and Registration menu items, favicon from the uploaded icon
